newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: WRMC has current public Music Director contacts but no published unsolicited-music delivery procedure on the reviewed official pages. The only approved action is one coordinated, asset-free process inquiry. A human must confirm external and international eligibility, formats, links, metadata, release timing, content and AI-origin rules before any release asset is supplied. Do not contact both Music Directors separately, attach files, send private links, target individual DJs or infer a postal submission route.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: The complete open pull-request patch and repository code index were searched for WRMC, WRMC 91.1, wrmc.middlebury.edu and both published Music Director addresses. No prior music-submission-agent platform, runtime seed or queue record was found.
deduplication.consolidation: The two co-Music Director contacts are stored as one canonical WRMC inquiry opportunity. They must not be queued as separate outreach targets. Individual DJs, other staff, app chat, the zine notice, library resources and the station address are excluded.

notes: One new free-first WRMC opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review for an asset-free process inquiry only. No email, form field, audio asset, link, login, CAPTCHA or payment was submitted.
